name: Event Processor Agent
description: Processes events and generates a list of channels and rule expressions to evaluate the event
inputSchemaDescription: Event capture schema matching EventCapture model.
outputSchemaDescription: Wrapper object containing the list of processed event results

name: Event Notification Scheduler Agent
description: Generates notification schedules for given events
inputSchemaDescription: Request for generating notification schedules for an event.
outputSchemaDescription: A list of triggers for the event

name: Log To Facts Agent
description: Extracts durable facts from raw event/notification logs.
inputSchemaDescription: Raw event and notification logs to be converted into facts.

name: MessageTemplateGenerator
description: Generates message templates for different communication channels (e.g., EMAIL, SMS) based on order or business event data. For EMAIL, generates rich HTML bodies with ${CONTENT_KEY} placeholders resolved from domain content. For other channels, generates plain-text templates.
inputSchemaDescription: Represents an Event and its payload used for template generation.

name: Rule Processor Agent
description: Converts natural language rule definitions to executable expressions using stored vocabulary terms
inputSchemaDescription: Request for converting a natural language rule definition to an executable expression.

name: Memory Summarization Agent
description: Summarizes streams of facts into concise human-readable summaries.

name: Event History Summarizer Agent
description: Compresses a list of recent ADK session event lines into a concise summary paragraph.
inputSchemaDescription: Raw session event lines to summarise.
outputSchemaDescription: Compact summary of recent session events.
